description: The MCP servers and skills the account watches, with their review level, slots and plans. Daily checks cover MCP tools, state, level, country and version, while supported skills cover SKILL.md text and review signals (source quotas can delay a check; read proxima_em and verificado_em). Alerts go to the verified account email with an unsubscribe link, and wallet-only owners read changes at `GET /api/me/vigia/avisos`.
